# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On October 26, 2020, PNM Resources, Inc., a New Mexico corporation, entered into an eighth amendment to its credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank (Administrative Agent) and a syndicate of lenders.
- The borrower is PNM Resources, Inc., which appears to be a utility company based in New Mexico.
